bottleneck_link: Rank shape is the one lever that raises the complex side's ceiling without touching the coverage law, the centre charge or the outer guard, and the complex side binds. The corrected curve says how much of a cap-s hop survives integrality, and the crossing cap shows the guard-cap arithmetic target is reached with both pools integral.
evidence: RESULT.json: 51 cap rows, each a bracket witnessed by an explicit joint integer packing and rejected by a certified lower bound; class relaxation reproduced against the pinned parent ceiling() at caps 8, 16 and 51; the live rank-cap column reproduced at its own grid at caps 44 and 51; the paid dynamic-program optimum equals the largest-first greedy cost at all 51 caps; crossing cap for a = 1/99 is 44 under the joint integer model; worst integrality loss over the curve 1.35033% against the published 0.66054%, which counts only the paid-mass rounding.

open_questions.blocked_by: The candidate histograms live inside their own packages; this package pins only the selected record, the parent model and the level-0 hook, not a candidate census.
open_questions.first_step: For each published candidate histogram, evaluate its own certified moment at the joint ceiling of its cap and compare it with the mixed figure it was screened against.
open_questions.question: Does any candidate packing that was screened against a cap-s ceiling survive the joint integer curve of the same class?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Such a candidate was screened against a figure that mixes an integer paid histogram with a fractional idle block. The certified joint curve is lower by up to 1.35% of the ceiling, so a candidate sitting near its own cap's ceiling can be rejected by the corrected value.

open_questions.blocked_by: The per-call idle masses of other words on a comparable template live inside their own packages, the same blocker the parent package records.
open_questions.first_step: Record the same rows at a second idle mass and port count and fit the two shares against the cap and the idle mass modulo the guard.
open_questions.question: Does the idle remainder's share of the integrality loss keep falling as the cap grows?
open_questions.why_it_matters: At cap 1 the whole loss is the idle rounding and at cap 51 the idle share is 0.51 of it, so the shape of the curve, not one constant, decides where integrality matters for a screening decision.

scope_change_reason: The card asks for one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, priced as a complete per-call profile. Its screening tool is the packing ceiling of the same local word, and the live rank-cap continuation of that tool reports a ceiling built from a fractional idle block plus an integer paid histogram, so its integrality-loss column measures only half of the rounding and its ceilings are not attainable by any real packing. This package first recomputes that whole class under integrality of both pools, certifies each cap in both directions and reproduces the published column as a control. No decoder, frame path or supplier is synthesized here, so the card's construction question is untouched; only the budget such a candidate would be screened against is corrected.
stop_rule: Stop after the 51-cap joint integer curve, its crossing cap, its integrality-loss curve and the reproduction of the published column. Do not extract idle histograms of other local words and do not enlarge the cap range beyond the halving guard.
